name: a-favourite-drag-shows-the-tile-at-its-new-slot
description:
A real cgevent drag of the first favourite past the second one. The row drag's gap put the tile back in its old slot and drew an outline at the new one. Only the dragged tile, dimmed at its new slot, may show where it lands.

The fixture draws two tiles centred at client 31x114 and 86x114. Screen coordinates are those plus the 30px the window sits below the screen top. The drop at 100x144 is right of the second tile's centre, so the first tile moves after it.

actions.expression: (() => { const grid = document.querySelector('[data-dropzone="favorites"]'); if (!grid) { return 'no-grid'; } return [...grid.querySelectorAll('.fav')].map((t) => { const b = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + 'x' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2); }).join(' '); })()

(() => { window.__ev = []; window.__look = []; window.__cs = []; for (const t of ['dragstart','dragover','drop','dragend']) { document.addEventListener(t, () => { if (window.__ev[window.__ev.length-1] !== t) { window.__ev.push(t); } }, true); } document.addEventListener('dragover', () => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (window.__ev.includes('drop')) { return; } const grid = document.querySelector('[data-dropzone="favorites"]'); const tiles = grid ? [...grid.querySelectorAll('.fav')] : []; const ghost = tiles.some((t) => t.classList.contains('favghost')); const at = tiles.findIndex((t) => t.classList.contains('favdragging')); const v = 'drag' + at + (ghost ? '+ghost' : ''); if (window.__look[window.__look.length-1] !== v) { window.__look.push(v); } }), true); const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name === 'sidebarFavoriteReordered') { window.__cs.push([name, args]); } return orig(name, args); }; return 'spying'; })()

assertions.desc: gates the drag: the tiles sit where the screen coordinates below assume
THE MEASUREMENT: no outline at any point, and the dimmed tile sat at its new slot
